description: ZoeyMemory: automatic journal + session context + two-machine sync. Every hook exits silently if the repo has no .claude/zoey-memory.json (i.e. /zoey-memory:init was never run). SessionStart runs ONE hook on purpose: it must pull BEFORE writing the session marker, and hooks on the same event run concurrently.
